run_maskrcnn_export_example: run the maskrcnn_export_caffe2_vs_torchvision_opset_format_example function to export a Mask R-CNN model to both Caffe2 and TorchScript formats
test_maskrcnn_export: test the TestOptimizer class to verify Mask R-CNN export produces equivalent outputs in Caffe2 and torchvision formats
export_maskrcnn_torchscript: export a Mask R-CNN model using GeneralizedRCNNRunner and the exporter main function to generate TorchScript predictor files
run_torchvision_inference: run inference on a torchvision-style exported model by passing a CHW image tensor and unpacking flattened output tensors
run_caffe2_inference: run inference on a caffe2-style exported model by passing data and im_info tensors and extracting roi_bbox_nms and roi_score_nms outputs
